translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Sa Namrlzbz Mz Leplz Mrkcng Amrlx Tqamrlz Yawe

content.text: Yawe, glqpxx nim, murde nim butqbr nyznge.
X alvztrpe' bange nzrpnangr x axplrq ninge mz nzotangr.
Brti drtwrnge nzngini-krm lrpalvc nyznge.
Nim Mevalu kx xplr x me rlakitrx.
Nim temz ngr lomrnge kc tqyrputrngr nipna.
X okatr-zvzq ninge mz nzaovxio-krnge lr mrkzbleng.
?A' memule tqmatq-ngrgr mz drtwrm?
?X memule tqmrlzti-ngrn nigr leplz txneng?
Nzmrbcnekr nzlukr leplz apule nzyrplaokr nrc kxesz'.
X apu-kzle zmio kc tqmrbr mz milzpq.
Yawe, lvxpx bongavz mz nzvzo-krme.
Maletr newz murde nasikapung nzapulr trmami.
Atwzlro-ngrm bzlrpc mz nzaodaliti-krm enqmi rngeng.
Pnzting nidr mz nipna scmqng murde navotxng.
Yawe, rtrngztiom ninge mz nzokatr-krm ninge,
Na-apule kx veclzme ninge me boongr prla.
X arlapxbz ninge mz mq lr mrkzbleng.
Murde nzmrlzti-txpwzlr nigr mz nzycmne-krdr.
A' trnzatutrlru nzesz'tikr drtwrgr badr.
Gct, sa nangr-ngrbo bam nabz kxmrna.
X na-angrlvzx nim mz nzayrni-krnge gita.
Murde okatr-zvzq king nemqng mz nzaovxio-krdrng.
X sc tqarlapxpebzme ninge mz toki r vea kxmalc, murde ninge kxnzawz nem.
Mzli ka arlapx-mopwz ninge mz mq lr mrkzbleng murde nzmrlzti-txpwzlr nigr mz nzycmne-krdr.
A' trnzatutrlru nzesz'tikr drtwrgr badr.
Delc mz nzkqlukr enqmi rgrng,
Krka'-ngrgr kx na-amrlzq nigr lr mrnyzm.
Murde obla negrng naxplrnelzm mz nzapu-krdr nounc kx xplr.
X olvi negrng naxplr-kzng x mztr nalqngi mz nzapu-krdr nctrpou ngr ma nyz king.
Dalr nrlanc nyzgrng nalvc-angidrng,
Murde bxli scgrng nayrbu zvz mz dakxnzng.
X animol negrng naeloting
Murde neidrng nayrlwrtxne.
X kxnzrmailz rgrng na-ale-zpwxlr nzwz-krdr,
Murde leplz ma tztangetrplr drkq ngr mztea nyzgr mz nzvzmi-krdr nigr mrnyzdr,
X lr mztea nyzgrng ma tzodalineng mz nzvzdz-krm nelzdr.
Yawe, leplz kcng tqokatrq mz da lcng, sa na-abrtz-ngrdr nzmnc-zpwx-krdr.
Murde leplz amrlx kcng tqnginim Gct rdr sa namnc-zpwx-zvzng.
